map.贴现率应该选多少？: What Discount Rate Should I Use?
map.通常取资金的机会成本：自身理财收益率、银行贷款利率或行业基准收益率。贴现率每抬高: Usually the opportunity cost of capital: your own investment return, a bank loan rate or an industry benchmark.
